scorerRelation.qualifyAiReviewEnsemble: Requires >=100 canonical, >=20 objective-corruption rows, both presentation kinds, semantic-label validation, and consistency. Its objective-corruption count is host construction count rather than independently confirmed critical truth. It cannot ingest exact-byte repeated presentation artifacts because it rejects duplicate canonicalArtifactHash values.
scorerRelation.qualifyCriticAgainstIndependentAiPanel: Requires >=100 canonical, >=20 panel-resolved critical rows, >=20 critic approval predictions, complete independent panel resolution, identical/reversed controls, >=0.95 approval precision, >=0.90 critical recall and >=0.80 decision coverage. The >=20 approval predicate counts critic predictions; at 0.95 precision it may permit only 19 independently confirmed approvals. It also rejects exact-byte presentation repetitions because artifact hashes must be globally unique.
requiredCorrectionBeforeQualification: Represent presentation controls by distinct presentation IDs bound to the same immutable artifact hash, while excluding them from canonical denominators.
Require at least 20 independently panel-resolved approvals, not merely 20 critic approve predictions.
Bind panel critical truth to corroborated named defect evidence; deterministic corruption alone is not a critical label.
Keep semantic recognition qualification disabled until exact artifacts and meanings/choices have independent provenance validation.

freshQualificationPlan.developmentV6Role: Keep all v6 rows in development calibration. The 90 unused rows may diagnose the frozen protocol but do not close a fresh qualification gate.

steps: Freeze final reviewer protocol and scorer before choosing qualification stimuli.

Select a new family-disjoint 100-canonical cohort from the 927-candidate census after alias/cluster/transitive-lineage validation; balance 25 per paint/native-size stratum and require 100 unique semantic families.
Create at least 20 independently corroboratable critical cases and at least 20 independently panel-resolved approval cases; keep presentation repetitions outside the 100 denominator.
Add exact-byte identical and reversed-order controls using repeated presentation IDs, freeze predictions before panel reveal, and require per-reviewer decision consistency.
Refuse qualification on missing predictions, unresolved panel labels, recognition provenance gaps, exposure overlap, or any hash/identity drift.
